name: polystrata
description: Fast, robust 2D straight-line B-rep and Boolean kernel in Rust/WASM and TypeScript

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path crates/polystrata-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('crates/polystrata-wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/polystrata_wasm.wasm');fs.writeFileSync('src/wasm-bytes.ts','// Auto-generated from crates/polystrata-wasm\nexport const WASM_BASE64 = \"'+b.toString('base64')+'\";\n');"
